jokes.title: Jokes
jokes.subtitle: Generate warmup videos with jokes and styled overlays.
instructions: Set the number of videos and duration per clip (3–30 sec).
Choose an output folder — generation requires it.
Optional: people photos (background), fonts (.ttf/.otf), and custom music (.mp3/.wav). Without custom music — auto-generated 8-bit melody.
In «Custom texts», enter one joke or phrase per line. Leave empty to use built-in templates.
Adjust music volume with the slider (custom tracks and 8-bit).
Click Generate and watch progress in the activity terminal.
Open finished files via Ready jokes or use them in automation (warm-up / upload).

jokes.customTextsHint: Leave empty for built-in templates. Texts cycle for each video.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.subtitle: Profiles are physically created in the anti-detect browser (Vision/MostLogin/ZennoBrowser) via its API. Each profile is a separate isolated browser session.

sections.title: Creating profiles
items: Paste proxies — format: ip:port:login:password, one per line
"Start from number" — profiles are named as numbers starting from it (5, 6, 7...)
"Profiles per proxy" = 3 → 3 profiles share one IP
Click "Create" — profiles appear in the browser and in the table

sections.title: Folders
items: Folders are real groups inside the browser, created there too
They appear in the filter above the table

sections.title: Proxies
items: "Replace proxy" — fully replaces the proxy on selected profiles
SpaceProxy — auto-fetches proxies via the API key from Settings
Dead proxy: the banned profile was deleted — replace its proxy on all other profiles still using it

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Storage for purchased Google accounts for convenient manual login via browser profiles. Before any automation, profiles must be logged in to YouTube.

sections.title: Import
items: Click "Import", paste a list or upload a file
Smart formatter automatically extracts email, password, and TOTP secret from any format
After import, manually log in to each account via a browser profile

sections.title: How to log in
items: Open the profile in the browser, go to the Google login page
Click email → it copies, paste into browser
Click password → it copies, paste it
Click TOTP code → 6-digit code copies (updates every 30 sec)
After copying all three fields the row is marked "Done"

sections.title: Delete authorized
items: Deletes accounts where all 3 fields were already copied — the ones you already logged into

sections.title: Blocks
items: Blocks are just a way to group batches of purchased accounts

automation.title: Automation
automation.subtitle: Run automated actions on authorized profiles. Profiles must already be logged in to YouTube before starting.

sections.title: How to run
items: Select profiles in the left panel (YouTube-authorized only)
Configure the needed tab: Warmup, Channel, or Upload
Set thread count — the number of simultaneously running profiles
Click "Run"

sections.title: Warmup
items: The account watches YouTube Shorts for the set duration
Set min/max session time and watch time per video
Enable likes and subscriptions with desired probability for natural behavior

sections.title: Channel setup
items: Uploads avatar and banner from specified folders
Sets channel name, description, and links
AI button generates name/description variants via DeepSeek API

sections.title: Video upload
items: Each profile receives one video from the folder
Title is picked randomly from the list (one per line)
"Feed browsing" — if the checkbox is on, after upload the account browses recommendations
Tags are picked randomly in a count from min to max

sections.title: Presets
items: Save settings from all tabs as a preset for quick switching
Ctrl+Shift+S — quick save of the active preset

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: Unlike the "Run" button in Automation — a task chains multiple modes together and can run automatically on a schedule.

sections.title: How to create a task
items: Click "Create", set a name and select profiles
Add chain steps: warmup → channel → upload
Drag steps to change execution order
Enable scheduling for auto-run at a set time or daily

sections.title: Sleep After
items: After the task completes, the computer automatically goes to Windows sleep mode

sections.title: Statuses
items: Idle → Running → Completed / Error / Stopped
Completed tasks go to Archive and are deleted automatically after 48 hours

jokes.title: Video Generator
jokes.subtitle: Generate short joke videos for YouTube Shorts. Output — ready-made mp4 files in 9:16 format.

sections.title: Preparation
items: Photo folder — images are used as video background
Music folder — custom background music (optional)
Fonts folder — for rendering joke text
Output folder — where finished videos are saved

sections.title: Music probability
items: Without a music folder — all videos use auto-generated 8-bit music
With folder: 50% = half the videos use custom music, half use 8-bit

sections.title: Generation
items: Set the number of videos and duration of each
Configure music volume
Click "Create" — finished mp4 files appear in the output folder

uniqueizer.title: Uniqualizer
uniqueizer.subtitle: Creates N unique copies from one source video with different visual and technical characteristics — for uploading to different YouTube channels.

sections.title: How to start
items: Specify the input folder with source videos
Specify the output folder for results
"Copies per video" = 3 → each source produces 3 unique files
Configure effects across tabs and click "Run"

sections.title: Overlays
items: Create your own overlay in the built-in editor (shapes, text, colors)
Or specify a folder with ready-made PNG/WebP files
"Generate textures" — unique textures are created automatically

sections.title: Other effects
items: Color correction — changes brightness and color balance
Audio — pitch shift, equalizer, sample rate change
Metadata — cleaning and replacing technical file data
Crop/zoom and micro-rotation — subtle geometric changes

sections.title: Important
items: Use the uniqualizer output folder as the video folder in the Upload section

results.title: Results
results.subtitle: Log of all videos uploaded via the software. A block is created automatically with each Upload run — videos are added as they upload in real time.

sections.title: Blocks
items: 1 automation run = 1 block (if at least one video was uploaded)
Videos appear in the block immediately after uploading to YouTube
You can create a block manually and paste links
Block merge — combines multiple runs into one to view overall stats

sections.title: Checker
items: Select a block and click "Check" — updates stats via YouTube Data API
Shows current views, likes, comments
Marks banned channels and deleted videos
Requires YouTube Data API key in Settings

sections.title: Export
items: "Export CSV" button — downloads all results as a spreadsheet

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Summary statistics for all videos. Data comes from the checker — the "Refresh" button queries YouTube API for fresh data.

sections.title: Metrics
items: Totals across all blocks: videos, views, likes, comments
Active profiles, sessions, banned profiles
Top 10 videos by views

sections.title: Charts
items: Views by day — filter 7 / 30 / 90 days
New videos by day
"Refresh" — queries fresh data from YouTube API (API key in Settings required)

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Application configuration. Start here — without API keys most features will not work.

sections.title: Appearance
items: Light/dark mode, color theme (6 presets)
Custom colors — set your own color for each UI element
Font: mono, sans-serif, or upload your own TTF/OTF file
Text size and interface language (RU / EN)

sections.title: Browser
items: Select active browser: Vision, MostLogin, or ZennoBrowser
Enter the API key — connection status is shown immediately

sections.title: API keys
items: YouTube Data API — for the checker in Results and Analytics
DeepSeek API — for AI text generation in Automation and Uniqualizer
SpaceProxy API — for auto-loading proxies in the Profiles section

sections.title: Notifications
items: Telegram Bot Token + Chat ID — notifications about checker results
Notifications are sent when the auto-checker finds bans or finishes a run

sections.title: Auto-checker
items: Automatically checks videos via YouTube API on a schedule
Configure interval (hours), which blocks to check: all, latest, or selected
Enable "Bans only" — notifications only when bans are detected
"Run now" button — manual check run

sections.title: System
items: Shows dependency status: Python, FFmpeg, Playwright
Without FFmpeg, Uniqualizer and Video Generator will not work
Without Playwright, Automation will not work

sections.title: Data
items: Create backup — saves all accounts, blocks, videos, and settings to a JSON file
Restore from backup — loads a JSON file and restores everything
Auto-backup — set a folder, backup is created automatically on schedule
Export CSV — export accounts or results as a spreadsheet
Reset settings — resets theme, fonts, and appearance to defaults

cabinet.title: Cabinet
cabinet.subtitle: Overall statistics for uploaded videos and automation runs.

sections.title: Statistics
items: Total automation runs
Total videos uploaded via the software
Views, likes, comments — totals across all Results blocks
Manually added links are excluded — only videos uploaded via automation are counted
"Refresh" button — fetches fresh data via YouTube API
